changelog: Verifies binary compatibility with Jellyfin 12.4 and retains 12.3 checks, with minimum ABI 12.2.0.0. Saves catalog cleanup before deleting old media. Preserves unreadable catalogs and retries after repair; playback skips prerolls on read failure. Serializes intro selection and watched writes to prevent concurrent duplicate reservations. Preserves strict genre matching, separate pools, Full HD/audio policy, settings and indexed item IDs.
description: Maintains separate recent and upcoming regular-movie and anime-movie trailer pools and plays same-genre trailers before movies.
name: Trailer Reel
overview: Recent and upcoming same-genre regular and anime movie trailers as Jellyfin prerolls.
